subject: Renewal request: SOC 2 scope change + 24mo log retention and burst capacity
messages:
From: Amanda Liu <amanda@lyra-fin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@lyra-fin.com
Date: 2026-11-01 09:12 PDT
Subject: Renewal request: SOC 2 scope change + 24mo log retention and burst capacity

Hi Priya / Connor,

Hope you're well. We're working through our FY27 vendor renewals and wanted to confirm a few items for Lyra Financial's contract renewal with Redwood:

- We need SOC 2 scope extended to include the new data export pipeline (PCI-adjacent) that went live in August.
- We must extend audit log retention for a subset of transaction logs to 24 months (current agreement is 12).
- During month-end peaks we need an explicit burst capacity clause: +30% dedicated GPU throughput for up to 72 hours per month for three months following renewal.

Can you confirm whether these are acceptable as managed amendments, what the impact on pricing would be, and what evidence (for SOC 2 delta) you'll provide during our re-attestation in Q1? Procurement asked that we get a redline and an attestation schedule by EOD Wednesday (11/3).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Amanda Liu
VP, Security & Compliance
Lyra Financial
[attachment: initial_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda@lyra-fin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal request: SOC 2 scope change + 24mo log retention and burst capacity

Amanda,

Thanks for the clear list — and congrats on the successful pipeline rollout. We can support all three asks, but there are a few dependencies to call out so we align expectations before procurement redlines the contract:

1) SOC 2 scope delta: We will produce a scoped addendum that documents the control mappings and the delta evidence set required for re-attestation. Typical delivery: initial delta package + evidence index within 10 business days of the amendment execution; full evidence handoff in our evidence staging environment within 25 business days.

2) Retention: Extending retention to 24 months for the specified transaction logs is feasible. There will be an incremental storage and access cost; I'll have Connor provide a sizing estimate and pricing uplift. We may also need to add a carriage policy for segmented access to those logs.

3) Burst capacity: We can add an explicit burst SLA (30% for up to 72 hours/month) for the first three months post-renewal. This will require reserving a burst pool on Dedicated and a short lead time for planned month-end windows; Connor will outline the operational steps.

I'll coordinate the redline and a draft amendment for legal review today and aim to send the package by EOD 11/2 so procurement has time to review. If procurement needs us to compress timelines, please flag which items are critical for signature vs. which can be handled as operational attachments.

Inbox note: attaching a short checklist of the evidence items we'll include in the delta package.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
[attachment: delta_evidence_checklist.txt (text/plain)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Amanda Liu <amanda@lyra-fin.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 08:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal request: SOC 2 scope change + 24mo log retention and burst capacity

Amanda / Priya — quick follow-up with estimates and operational notes.

- Retention sizing: Based on the sample throughput you shared, 24mo retention for the transaction subset adds ~1.1TB compressed across our ingest pipeline and archive tiers. Incremental cost estimate: $2,800/mo (region-us) for storage + $0.02/GB egress for on-demand exports.

- Burst capacity: To guarantee +30% throughput during month-end windows we recommend the following: (a) pre-book burst windows 7 days in advance, (b) a one-time setup fee to reserve the burst pool capacity ($6,000), and (c) a temporary uplift rate of 1.25x CPU/GPU token rate for the burst period. The attached spreadsheet shows a 3-month total uplift estimate.

- Evidence delivery: we'll provide a delta attestation bundle containing control narratives, change logs, and filtered sampling of logs from the new pipeline. We will not include raw PII extracts; all samples will be redacted and provided in the evidence staging tenant.

Attaching: Retention_Matrix.xlsx and a draft amendment (Redwood_Amendment_v1.docx) with the proposed wording.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Retention_Matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-02 14:22 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal request: SOC 2 scope change + 24mo log retention and burst capacity

Amanda / all — looping in legal commentary / commercial redline highlights.

- We've added a short amendment clause for "Scope Extension: Data Export Pipeline" that limits the delta to the specified services and requires Redwood to maintain control mappings for re-attestation.
- Retention: added a cost schedule table (monthly incremental and transition fees). Also included a clause for "Retention Carveouts" to allow Lyra to request temporary exports under specified legal requests.
- Burst: added operational pre-notice (7 days) and an emergency burst process (24 hour notice) for one-off approved events. Pricing for emergency bursts will be an agreed one-time fee.

Next step: Priya/Connor, please confirm you are comfortable with the operational SLAs in the draft. Amanda, if this draft tracks with procurement, I can convert to a DocuSign envelope and route for signature.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
